items.item_text: resume
cover letter
At least six months of experience in a custodial cleaning operation or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

The Senior Custodian assists with training for the custodial team and communicates safety and operational concerns to the Unit Safety Committee Representatives. This position collaborates with the manager and the Custodial Lead to conduct safety training in the unit. The Senior Custodian is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, sanitary, and welcoming environment throughout International House by performing a full range of custodial, floor-care, and facility-support services.
Sweep and mop stairs, hallways, and outside areas.

This position independently performs routine and specialized cleaning of residential, administrative, and common areas; operates and maintains commercial custodial equipment; and completes custodial projects to ensure facilities meet established cleanliness and safety standards. The Senior Custodian performs comprehensive cleaning and sanitization of restrooms, resident rooms, offices, hallways, stairwells, lounges, and other assigned spaces, including floor care, carpet maintenance, window cleaning, waste removal, supply replenishment, and minor maintenance support.
Dust, clean, wax, and/or polish furniture, woodwork, light fixtures, venetian blinds, radiators, grills, ducts, blackboards, filing cabinets, and other designated areas of equipment.

Additionally, the Senior Custodian assists with student room turnover during move-in and move-out periods, reports facility maintenance needs, and safely moves custodial equipment and materials as required. Working with minimal supervision, the Senior Custodian prioritizes daily assignments, responds to changing operational needs, and may provide coverage during the absence of other custodial staff to ensure uninterrupted services. The Senior Custodian maintains a professional, customer-service-oriented approach when communicating with supervisors, coworkers, residents, and guests. This position safely operates a variety of commercial cleaning equipment, follows established security and building access procedures, complies with all applicable safety regulations and University policies, and ensures a safe workplace by properly using personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly reporting unsafe conditions.
Empties wastebaskets and recycling containers.
Mop, clean, and disinfect restrooms, shower rooms, and locker rooms, and replenish supplies.
Wash doors, patrician glass, mirrors, showcases, glass panels, inside windows, and outside windows at ground level.
Polish metal fixtures, empty and clean ashtrays, wastebaskets, and other receptacles.
Unclog minor drain stoppages.
Vacuum rugs, draperies, upholstered furniture, mattresses, pillows, or other designated materials.
Operates floor buffers, shampoo machine, wet/dry vacuums, waxers, floor scrubbing and/or polishing machines during stripping, waxing, buffing, and/or other related cleaning operations.
Have security responsibility for one or more assigned areas.
Assist in the setting up and dismantling of special equipment at functions.
Assist with training new team members, train custodians on effective task execution, and safe equipment use.
Load and/or unload large trash receptacles.
Perform specialized cleaning in isolation and terminal areas as required.
Act as a work leader for a small group of Custodians (usually less than 5).
Demonstrated ability to read, write, and follow oral and written instructions in English.
Knowledge of cleaning products and methods used to maintain different types of floor surfaces (tile, wood, cement, carpet).
Knowledge of healthy and safe work practices and personal protective equipment (PPE)
Ability to occasionally lift and move up to 30 lb
